mentions.name: Nola
mentions.description: Nola is a programming language project hosted on GitHub (nola-lang/nola), built over three months and publicly released a week ago. It embodies a start-small philosophy: release sooner rather than trying to build everything at once.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been building Nola for the last 3 months. Even slept a bit sometimes.

Finally released it a week ago and got 4 GitHub stars. Yooohooo

It was worth it. 4 f*king stars.

I'm living proof that sometimes we overcomplicate things. Start smaller, release sooner, and don't try to build everything at once.

But I keep going

This 4-star legend:
https://github.com/nola-lang/nola
